about_the_game:
Hello and Welcome!

Snapshot Aquarium is an aquarium simulator / shooter hybrid where you unlock new content by shooting pictures of fish.

Features implemented so far:

Arcade-style photo challenges

  • easy: non-frustrating, with auto-aim and auto-focus

  • regular: manual aiming, auto-focus

  • hardcore: manual aiming, manual focus

Aquarium Editing

  • design beautiful habitats for your fish, as seen in the gameplay video

  • more than 300 items are included already, more will be added after release

Online Community Challenges

  • Visit and accomplish challenges in other player's aquariums

  • Share your own aquariums and get visitors from all over the world!

Basic Fish AI

  • Schooling, fleeing, feeding, growing in near-realtime

  • Aggressive fish chase others

Features planned:

  • Realistic fish needs and happiness (certain plants, school size, ...)

  • Community photo quests (find the fish!)

  • More realistic fish AI and animation

  • Loads of new content

  • ... ? (Suggestions are welcome! We love working on this tile and don't plan to stop anytime soon)

We hope you enjoy the game already, feedback and suggestions are highly appreciated!

Love, peace and cheers,
Team Octoponx

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 8th gen, Ryzen 3 5300U
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GTX 750 Ti, Radeon Vega 8
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 9th gen, Ryzen 5 3400G
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GTX 1660, Radeon 680M
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Welcome to Snapshot Aquarium, the cozy aquarium sim with hardcore shooting mechanics! Build peaceful habitats and unlock all content through photo safaris. No skill wall – just patience, creativity, and fish. Visit aquariums from players around the world – and share your own.
